# The tests protect what a first-link or recovery Discard of a rules file lets in: every entry its rules
# excluded is held and asked about before anything uploads. No earlier test discards a rules file
# that still excludes entries, so none of these paths was reached before.
# The failing-write test runs the server-replace answer in three modes (download unavailable while the
# folder is renamed, folder read-only, name taken by another entry). These are the only states where
# the record has to wait across commits, and each mode blocks the write at a different step.
# The restart test's upgrade variant opens the store the previous release leaves between the answer and
# the rules leaving. The alpha6 upgrade case opens a store with no discard pending, so it can't reach this.
# The lifecycle test ends a record by deleting or renaming the folder, restoring or editing the rules
# file, and asking the question again. Each end path is a separate branch in the judge.
# The unread-folder test keeps the record while a folder below it can't be read, and the recovery test
# discards a rules file through a recovery question. No other test makes a scan fail below the folder or
# discards a rules file through recovery.
